conclusions: Any zero baseline process median makes its ratio null; one such pair prevents a passing ratio-only GC gate.
Repeating observations that remain all zero cannot resolve it. Zero GC is not zero allocation.
B/B upper-CI<=1 is directional, not an independently specified stability test. Straddling equality alone does not establish host instability.
Exact positive equality can pass B/B. This review does not prove that every future B/B experiment must block.
Policy clarification cannot repair measured slowdowns or replace the required fresh grid and attribution.
